text:
ingrid_support: Heads-up — multiple customers reporting 401 + retry storm since this morning. Started after last SDK regen? Details below.

sam_engineer: Which SDKs? TS/Python/Go?

ingrid_support: TS and Python so far. Repro in TS repro app from support:
```js
fetch('/v1/generate', {
  headers: {
    'Authorization': `Bearer ${TOKEN}`,
    'X-Retry-After': '0'
  }
})
```
Response: 401 with no WWW-Authenticate, then client retries repeatedly.

morgan_sdk: That header ordering change rings a bell — during the regen our OpenAPI codegen accidentally moved `Authorization` to after other custom headers for node-fetch wrapper. Some auth middleware expects Authorization to be first (ugh).

leo_devex: Any quick bisect? CI job id: `regen-client/2026-03-12` changed header serialization.

ci-bot: @morgan_sdk triggered a regen pipeline: https://ci.internal/regen-client/2026-03-12

sam_engineer: Is this causing billing spikes? Retries could double charge attempts.

ingrid_support: Yes — two customers reported unexpected token usage increase. Need rollback if confirmed.

morgan_sdk: Patch incoming. Short-term mitigation: add guard in runtime to not auto-retry on 401 unless challenge header present, and ensure Authorization header is first in header list.

infra-bot: Rolling back `regen-client/2026-03-12` to previous artifact at 2026-03-11-2100.

jess_sales: Looping in account managers for affected customers. Any ETA on release fix?

morgan_sdk: I'll open a PR with tests that assert header order and a kitchen-test against our auth proxy. Targeting hotfix within 2 hours.

leo_devex: Also add a changelog note about header serialization change. We missed a backwards-compat flag in generator.

ingrid_support: Thanks. I'll update support threads and block billing adjustments until we verify.

sam_engineer: If anyone has quick repro in Go or Python, drop minimal snippet. We'll verify proxy behavior.

morgan_sdk: Pushed hotfix PR: #4321 — adding `preserveHeaderOrder: true` in generator config. CI run queued.

ci-bot: CI passed for PR #4321, merging.

ingrid_support: Monitoring customer apps — messages already dying down :thumbsup:

jess_sales: Thanks team, please post postmortem in #postmortems when stable.

ingrid_support: Will do.
